info.name: Coveo Activity Activities Insight Panel API

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
Example: `mycoveocloudv2organizationg8tp8wu3`

params.name: page
params.description: The 0-based number of the page of configurations to list.

params.name: perPage
params.description: The number of configurations to list per page. Must be equal to or greater than 1.

params.name: filter
params.description: A filter that only retrieves matching Insight Panel configurations.

params.name: order
params.description:
The order in which the configurations are listed. The available values are:
  • empty: items are not sorted in any specific order.
  • asc: items are sorted in ascending order.
  • desc: items are sorted in descending order.

- `desc`: descending order
